caption_search_cues.caption_excerpt: Fig. 1: Method Overview: A task solver is pre-trained in simulation to solve tasks that are autonomously proposed by a task generator (left). The solver discovers diverse behaviors and embeds them in its primitives. On each downstream task, an orchestrator is trained to reuse the pre-trained primitives (middle). Downstream agents are transferred to a real robotic platform (right). Abstract— Learning skills that interact with objects is of major i

Figure 1. A. Discovering Behaviors through Tasks Diversity The core of our method is the pre-training part. It requires a task generator and a task solver. The role of the generator is to propose tasks that the solver must solve. Our method relies on the hypothesis that if the set of tasks proposed by the generator is large, diverse, and complex, then it induces the discovery of diverse and complex behaviors by the solver.
